## vb.register_block

`vb.register_block(def) -> BlockId`

context: **load** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Registers a block type and returns its id. Block ids follow registration order and saved worlds store ids, so keep the order stable.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `def` | `BlockDef` |  |

Returns `BlockId`

```lua
local ruby = vb.register_block{ name = "mypack:ruby", texture = "textures/ruby.png", max_damage = 3 }
```

## vb.register_entity

## vb.register_biome

## vb.register_craft

`vb.register_craft(def)`

context: **load** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Captures a crafting recipe (the engine does not read it back; `content/base/crafting.lua` is an example consumer).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `def` | `CraftDef` |  |

```lua
vb.register_craft{ name = "mypack:planks", inputs = { { item = 1, count = 1 } }, output = { item = 2, count = 4 } }
```

## vb.register_keybind

`vb.register_keybind(name) -> integer`

context: **load** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Declares a custom input slot and returns its bit index (max 32). Idempotent by name. The engine names (`jump`, `sprint`, ...) are pre-registered.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |

Returns `integer` — index

```lua
vb.register_keybind("dash")
vb.on("player_input", function(player, input)
 if input.keybinds.dash then return { move = { z = 2.0 } } end
end)
```

## vb.on

`vb.on(event, handler)`

context: **runtime** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Subscribes `handler` to an engine event. Handler arguments depend on the event; see `events.lua`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | `VbEvent` |  |
| `handler` | `function` |  |

```lua
vb.on("chat", function(player, text) if text == "boo" then return false end end)
```

## vb.after

`vb.after(seconds, fn)`

context: **runtime** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Runs `fn` once after `seconds`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | `number` |  |
| `fn` | `fun()` |  |

```lua
vb.after(5, function() print("five seconds later") end)
```

## vb.every

`vb.every(seconds, fn)`

context: **runtime** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Runs `fn` every `seconds` (catches up on a stalled tick, capped at 8 fires per dispatch).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | `number` |  |
| `fn` | `fun()` |  |

```lua
vb.every(60, function() print("a minute passed") end)
```

## vb.storage

`vb.storage`

context: **runtime** · since: **0.1.0**

Server pack VM only. Persistent pack-global key/value store, saved to `<pack>/storage.json`. Assigning `nil` is allowed; values are JSON-compatible (numbers, strings, booleans, tables).

```lua
vb.storage.visits = (vb.storage.visits or 0) + 1
```
